verdict.rationale: The only direct export evidence is that tool-call audit records are 'exportable', which covers just one slice of a user's data. Nothing documents a full account or data export, the export format, or a way to leave. Tool sources being user-authored OpenAPI documents and TypeScript functions, and skills being SKILL.md manifests, suggests some portability but is not an export capability. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export (servers, toolsets, policies, skills, logs), named open export formats, offboarding or account-deletion guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Every tool call in one exportable record, tied to a named employee
